label: No mutual necessary support, from actual well-foundedness and no novel edge (inference)
rule: Composition of unionWFOfNoNovel with the existing mutualSupport_excludes
meaning: Prices the mutual-support rival of J2: with reflexive access at w and well-founded actual grounding at w (both premises of the join the rival was tested against), the rival is incompatible with the one-way no-novel-edge condition. A holder of the rival who accepts the join's other premises must therefore posit a support edge between two necessary concreta that holds at some world but not at w: the direction of support between necessary beings is contingent. A conditional exclusion; neither the condition nor the rival is established or refuted.
